name: Brevo
description: Connect Brevo to Claude to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. Claude can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. Claude will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brevo.com/v1/anthropic/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brevo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brevo lists 21 MCP tools, including accounts_get_account, senders_get_senders, contacts_get_contacts, attributes_get_attributes, lists_get_lists, lists_get_list, contact_import_export_get_contacts_from_list, segments_get_segments, contacts_get_contact_info, contacts_get_contact_stats, email_campaign_management_get_email_campaigns, and email_campaign_management_create_email_campaign.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brevo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brevo in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Brevo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brevo is developed by Brevo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
